scope: Original bounded LLVM disassembly plus PE literal bytes; target not executed; not REA native provider

observedRules.rule: A file-content helper is retried on false; Sleep100ms between failures up to10 iterations. Helper exact read/encoding behavior unverified.
First newline required; missing newline takes cleanup path before header and entries are added.
First-line substring is parsed through numeric helper and assigned to output dword+8.
Find first section-sign delimiter after current cursor; absence exits entries loop.
Prefix before first delimiter is parsed as hex through helper whose PE format literal is %x.
Find second section-sign; middle substring retained as string; absent delimiter exits entries loop.
Final numeric substring terminates at newline or end-of-buffer if newline missing.
Container helper called with first numeric value; nested helper called with middle string; status assigned afterward.
Status 0 or 0xffffffff follows invalid branch: stores0xffffffff and clears associated string+0x30; other unsigned values are accepted.
Numeric helper initializes output to0, calls scanner with %x, ignores scanner return count and returns local output.

formatModel: hex header newline; repeated hex outer key § middle string § hex status newline. Exact key/string/status semantic names unverified.
integratedDesignImplications: Separate FileFinder persistence from semantic references and inspection compilation caches.
Treat header-context mismatch and partial entry loads as explicit states.
Do not assume parsing is transactional: entries are processed incrementally before malformed later delimiter terminates loop.
Model retry budgets and thread affinity separately from CPU-use assumptions.
comparisonCases: Partial read failure and retry exhaustion
unknowns: Actual read helper UTF16 normalization and filesystem errors
Container insertion semantics and duplicate keys
Atomicity and lifecycle after partial load
